notes: Provisional values. status: sourced = from the cited source; to_verify = secondary or dated source, to be checked against the primary data; assumption = declared assumption. Ranges min/mid/max are propagated by the engine up to the final result.

device_power_w.method: Device power while the tab is active. Laptop ~9-13 W; desktop+monitor higher. The central value is an assumption between the two cases; it will become configurable.

network_dc_kwh_per_gb.method: Data center 0.055 + network 0.059 kWh/GB (SWD v4, operational only). The SWD 'device' segment is NOT used: the device is computed from time to avoid double counting. Range = x0.5 / x2 (assumption: the kWh/GB model is debated in the literature).

streaming_kwh_per_hour.method: Network + data center per hour of streaming; replaces the byte-based calculation (which would overestimate streaming). Max = earlier IEA estimate (0.12-0.24). Possible slight double counting with the device.

ai_text_wh_per_prompt.method: Gemini median 0.24 Wh (comprehensive method); 0.10 Wh = active chips only. Max = assumption (x3) for heavier models.

ai_text_prompts_per_hour.method: The browser cannot see prompts: a usage rate per hour of active session is assumed. TO BE DEEPENED.

ai_image_wh_per_image.method: From 1.35 (median) to 11.49 kWh per 1000 images; values from secondary sources. Depends on model and image size.

ai_image_images_per_hour.method: Assumed usage rate per active hour. TO BE DEEPENED.

ai_video.method: No reliable coefficient collected: the remote part is not estimated (only device and network are counted). TO BE DEEPENED.

water_l_per_kwh.method: Direct water (cooling, ~1.8 L/kWh) and indirect water (power generation, up to ~7.6 L/kWh) from secondary sources. The central value is an assumed midpoint; to be refined per country.

reference_thresholds_wh_per_day.method: Default traffic-light thresholds (green/yellow/red) expressed as daily energy, converted with the selected profile. Reference: ~8 h of device at 20 W = 160 Wh. These are NOT scientific or regulatory thresholds: users can set their own.
